clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Sergra Darkthorn awaits the pale hide of Whitemist, the legendary white lion of the Barrens. Tauren honor the beast as an embodiment of mercy and death, while hunters bring the pelt as proof of their prowess.

Echeyakee means Whitemist in the Taur-ahe tongue. The lion earned that name among the savannah's predators for his stealthy white coat and swift kills, ending prey's lives before fear or pain could take hold. A hunter summons the elusive cat near the giant kodo bones northeast of the Crossroads with a ceremonial horn, then claims his pelt. Bringing it to Sergra Darkthorn proves martial skill and honors Whitemist's silent, merciful end.
